description: External signer interface (SPEC-v2 §3.2). Each case decodes object_b64, discards its signature, and signs it again with the SDK's typed signing function for kind through the SDK's external signer interface, bound to a scripted provider. The provider records every request and answers with fixed bytes. A signed result must equal signed_wire_b64 byte for byte (the corpus is deterministic), and the recorded request must equal expected.request exactly. An error returns no object and must carry error_class.

semantics.caller_cancelled: true: the caller's cancellation is signalled before the typed signing function is called
semantics.error classes: a reported key that is not the key the object names is key_id_mismatch, and for a revocation object a reported key that is not the status key the configuration binds to the issuer is status_key_binding_mismatch; in both cases the provider is never asked to sign; a returned component that is missing, malformed, or does not verify over M under the bound key and registry context is invalid_signature and both components are discarded; a provider error is configuration_invalid; a cancellation before or during the call is evaluation_cancelled and a signature returned after it is discarded
semantics.expected.request: the single request the provider received: mode, M (message_b64), mldsa_context (direct) or mldsa_mu_b64 (external_mu), the other null, and the bound key's key_id_v2
semantics.kind: delegation_certificate: the typed certificate signer (the signer key must be the issuer key the certificate carries); revocation_list: the typed list signer with binding (the authenticated issuer and status key, a keys.json name; the signer key must be that status key); proof_bundle: the typed presentation signer (the signer key must be the agent key)
semantics.provider: public_key is the keys.json name of the complete key the provider reports when bound. mode is direct (the provider receives M and the 22-byte registry context) or external_mu (it receives only the 64-byte mu). response signature returns signature as given (a component given as an empty string is missing); error returns a provider error; cancel signals the caller's cancellation during the call and then returns signature

cases.name: delegation_certificate_direct
cases.description: a direct-mode provider receives M and the registry context and returns a valid signature

cases.name: delegation_certificate_external_mu
cases.description: an external-mu provider receives only mu, derived from the bound ML-DSA-65 key, the registry context, and M

cases.name: delegation_certificate_key_binding_mismatch
cases.description: the provider reports a complete key other than the certificate's issuer key: key_id_mismatch before any signing request

cases.name: delegation_certificate_ed25519_component_invalid
cases.description: the returned Ed25519 component has one bit flipped: verify-before-use rejects it

cases.name: delegation_certificate_ml_dsa_65_component_invalid
cases.description: the returned ML-DSA-65 component has one bit flipped: verify-before-use rejects it

cases.name: delegation_certificate_ml_dsa_65_component_missing
cases.description: the provider returns no ML-DSA-65 component

cases.name: delegation_certificate_signature_by_other_key
cases.description: the provider reports the issuer key but returns a valid signature over M made with another key

cases.name: delegation_certificate_signature_under_other_code
cases.description: the provider returns the issuer's signature over the same signable bytes under code 0x0002

cases.name: delegation_certificate_provider_error
cases.description: the provider fails: signing fails and no object is returned

cases.name: delegation_certificate_cancelled_before_call
cases.description: the caller cancelled before signing: the provider is never called

cases.name: delegation_certificate_cancelled_during_call
cases.description: the caller cancels while the provider is signing; the valid signature that arrives afterwards is discarded

cases.name: revocation_list_external_mu
cases.description: the configured status key signs a list through an external-mu provider

cases.name: revocation_list_key_binding_mismatch
cases.description: the provider reports another issuer's status key than the configuration binds to this issuer

cases.name: revocation_list_ml_dsa_65_component_invalid
cases.description: the returned ML-DSA-65 component has one bit flipped

cases.name: proof_bundle_direct
cases.description: the agent signs the challenge presentation (code 0x0002) through a direct-mode provider

cases.name: proof_bundle_key_binding_mismatch
cases.description: the provider reports a key other than the bundle's agent key

cases.name: proof_bundle_ed25519_component_invalid
cases.description: the returned Ed25519 component has one bit flipped
